$comment: What an icon file in assets/icons/ may hold. scripts/plugin-assets.mjs checks every icon against this before writing it, and tests/IconsTest.php checks the files that ship. Only Lucide's plain shapes and drawing attributes: nothing that runs, links or loads, and no text. A value may hold only the characters in `value`; `xmlns` must be `namespace`. An icon's name, which becomes its file name, must match `name`. The templates inline these files into GSL's pages (WORDPRESS-PLAN.md, Phase 3).
name: ^[a-z0-9-]+$
